title: Weedie's Technological Cookstravaganza
description: This is a pack dedicated to technology and cooking.
body:
A technology and cooking themed pack where the main tech mods are Mekanism, Create, and Modern Industrialization. For food and cooking we include Farmers Delight W/Addons, Croptopia, and pam's harvestcraft.

Worldgen includes Terralith with Biomes o Plenty.

Sodium is not included due to compatibility issues but may be added in a future update.
